short_description: Consumer-facing body trait that reports a cautious panel-relative signal for left arm mass tendency within the current local reference panel.
summary_note: Usable consumer-facing body trait with workable raw-array support and a clear interpretation boundary between inherited tendency and real-world phenotype or behavior.
what_it_measures: A panel-relative polygenic signal associated with left arm mass tendency, calibrated within the current local empirical reference panel.
interpretation_template: Left arm mass tendency is presented here as a cautious relative signal, not a direct measurement of the current real-world trait. {interpretation}
caution_text: Use as a cautious panel-relative signal only. No imputation or ancestry-adjusted normalization is used, and the output should not be treated as deterministic, diagnostic, medical, or lifestyle advice.
limitations: Percentiles and z-scores are relative to the local reference panel, not to a population-wide benchmark.
Real-world outcomes depend on environment, habits, culture, age, sex, health, and personal context.
This trait should be read as an exploratory consumer signal only.
confidence_note: Confidence reflects overlap and reference robustness under the no-imputation raw-array workflow, not certainty about the real-world trait.
reference_note: Percentiles and z-scores are calibrated against a local empirical reference artifact built from all parseable raw-array files under the local Autosomal folder; they are panel-relative, not population-wide.
